primary_family: Four prespecified synthetic modules, each containing four matched RNA/protein pairs
primary_metric: Detection probability of altered module 1, plus any false module
secondary_family: Sixteen prespecified gene/protein pairs, reported separately from the module family
intervals: Wilson 95% intervals conditional on the realised calibration bank; paired bootstrap with independent resampling of each calibration bank and evaluation cohorts for selected method contrasts
integration_intervals: Paired percentile bootstrap over independent training/test pairs, 2000 resamples; descriptive with 12 replicates per cell
protein_reference: Also calculate the covariate-only protein prediction baseline from exported original training/test matrices using the same train-fitted preprocessing and ridge protocol; no molecular model fitting or selection uses this reference.
diagnostic_sensitivity: Retain every successful fit in primary results. Also report paired contrasts restricted to replicates where both selected method diagnostics pass, with sample counts. This diagnostic-based subset is a sensitivity analysis, not a replacement or evidence of unbiased selection.
no_claims: No joint 5% guarantee across the gene and module families
No universal superiority from selected contrasts
